newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar tightly mixed in light trade.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar tightly mixed in light trade.

text.p: LIFFE sugar was tightly mixed in light morning trade.
By 1005 GMT front month October was 60 cents higher at $330.40.
Total volume was just 45 lots, 23 of them on October.

The market lacked any direction and appeared to be taking a breather after a high close on Tuesday, one trader noted. Any further move to the upside would depend on when funds came in and bought. "The upside is difficult to predict," he said.
A down move would be likely to run into trade buying, he reckoned.
The first Dutch sugar beet forecast for 1997 showed a yield of 9.4 tonnes per hectare white value, up from 9.3 tonnes in 1996, the Institute for Sugar Research (IRS) said on Tuesday.
